errors.error_description: Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same sequential clocked block by using a blocking assignment to 'busy' while other registers use non-blocking.
Used case equality operator '===' for synthesizable control logic in an RTL if-condition comparing 'cmd' to a constant.
Assigned a 16-bit signal 'data_in' to an 8-bit register 'acc_next', causing silent truncation.
Inserted a stray semicolon after an if-condition, creating an empty statement and decoupling the following begin-end block from the condition.
